resolutionRules.sourceCondition: Never join website data on Thai name, English name, URL slug, or workbook ID.
resolutionRules.normalizedAction: Join only after Area_Crosswalk has assigned provinceCode/districtCode/subdistrictCode.

resolutionRules.sourceCondition: Workbook ID is a source research identifier, not an official administrative code.
resolutionRules.normalizedAction: Store as sourceResearchId and use canonical subdistrictCode for website joins.

resolutionRules.sourceCondition: Source row ID 222 labels Nong Rawiang under Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima, creating one extra area there and one missing Phimai area.
resolutionRules.normalizedAction: Correct sourceAmphoeEnCorrected to Phimai and map to subdistrictCode 301512.

resolutionRules.sourceCondition: Geodata English labels can be inconsistent with Thai/admin-code evidence.
resolutionRules.normalizedAction: Override only specific English labels where Thai name and admin code prove the intended area.

resolutionRules.sourceCondition: Source value Irragation is a spelling typo.
resolutionRules.normalizedAction: Normalize to Irrigation; retain original Irragation in raw sheets and source field.

resolutionRules.sourceCondition: Rainfall duplicate keys have identical Best_Station_Rainfall values in this export.
resolutionRules.normalizedAction: Keep one normalized monthly record; retain source row numbers and duplicate counts.

resolutionRules.sourceCondition: Drought duplicate keys sometimes disagree on Drought_Risk class.
resolutionRules.normalizedAction: Keep one normalized monthly record using conservative maximum; set droughtRiskConflict=true and retain all raw class values/source rows.

resolutionRules.sourceCondition: This workbook is research/historical evidence, not ThaiWater live operational truth.
resolutionRules.normalizedAction: Use DERIVED for rainfall/risk values until source/station lineage is confirmed per record.

resolutionRules.sourceCondition: Official ThaiWater operational data prevails if it conflicts with this normalized workbook.
resolutionRules.normalizedAction: Treat this workbook as historical/model context when ThaiWater live data is present.
